facts.fact: Zane 替两人放了浴水，Caroline 推辞说他不必如此，他坚持不放，她心里感激。
facts.anchor: He ran a bath for us. I assured Zane the gesture was unnecessary, but he would not be dissuaded. Thank heavens he insisted.

facts.fact: Caroline 承认 Zane 每多一分温柔，她对 Orson 的愤怒就成倍增长。
facts.anchor: Except the more Zane cared for me, another emotion increased exponentially—anger.

facts.fact: Zane 肯定她「我恨他」的说法，说 Orson 拥有了世上最珍贵的礼物却从不珍惜。
facts.anchor: You should hate him. He had the greatest gift in the world and never treated it with the reverence or care it deserved.

facts.fact: Zane 说到「我无法——」时被 Caroline 吻住打断，她承受不了也接受不了这份爱意。
facts.anchor: I kissed him, cutting off the words. I couldn’t bear to hear them. Couldn’t accept them.

facts.fact: 接下来一周两人形成固定作息：白天 Zane 在书房处理交易所的账目，Caroline 去图书馆整理藏书。
facts.anchor: I spent the days working in my office, catching up on the Exchange, and she went to the library, exploring and organizing.

facts.fact: Zane 有一句一直烧在舌头上没出口的话，他说自己感受极深，她不在身边时他几乎无法呼吸。
facts.anchor: But I felt them. Deeply. I could hardly breathe when she was out of my presence.

facts.fact: Zane 读到 Fletcher 送来的急信后告诉 Caroline：Orson 已回到纽约、聘请律师，要挑战离婚。
facts.anchor: Orson has returned to New York. He has hired a lawyer and is challenging the divorce.

facts.fact: 管家 Branson 报告行李已收拾好，二十分钟后有一班开往纽约的火车到站。
facts.anchor: There is a train bound for New York arriving at the station in twenty minutes.

facts.fact: Caroline 拒绝被留下，指出 Zane 命令她不许去纽约的语气和 Orson 一模一样，坚持要一起去纽约。
facts.anchor: Forbid it? Do you hear yourself? You sound exactly like him.
